name: ChangeThisFile
description: ChangeThisFile converts files between 690+ formats across images, video, audio, documents, data files, fonts, ebooks, and archives. Two tools: convert_file accepts a public URL or base64 content plus a target format and returns a temporary signed download URL (valid 1 hour; files deleted within 24 hours); list_conversions enumerates every supported route, filterable by source format. Conversions run on managed engines (FFmpeg, LibreOffice, Calibre, 7-Zip, sharp, Ghostscript). No account, API key, or OAuth required; per-IP rate limiting applies.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ChangeThisFile to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ChangeThisFile to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://changethisfile.com/mcp.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ChangeThisFile MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ChangeThisFile provides these MCP tools: convert_file, source_url, base64_content, target_format, and list_conversions.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ChangeThisFile?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ChangeThisFile in business-productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Pyth, Domhaul, Idiolect AI, aster-share, and aquent-jobs.
ChangeThisFile does not require authentication. It is a public MCP endpoint you can connect without logging in.
ChangeThisFile is developed by Sovereign Firm. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
